verdict.rationale: A developer-facing API service could plausibly ship starter project templates, so the axis applies. The pack shows no library of ready-made project templates. The `x-preset` option bundles, the code builder, and the prebuilt container image are adjacent features: request-parameter presets and deployment conveniences, not project templates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
